Trainable gated recurrent unit sequence layer.

Engine training supports unidirectional and split-path bidirectional GRU with dropout=0.0; each direction runs as an independent single-direction GRU on ArrayFire (the selected device), or on the native neural provider when one serves the run's device.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Recurrent](../categories/recurrent.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | gru, recurrent, sequence |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Sequence tensor [batch, sequence, features]; features is derived as input_size. |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Full sequence [batch, sequence, hidden \* directions] when return_sequences=true; otherwise [batch, hidden \* directions]. |
| **Hidden** | Tensor | No | 1 | Legacy compatibility pin only. Engine SequentialModel does not route a separate h_n output; leave disconnected. |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Recurrent | Input Size | `input_size` | Integer | `0` | `Derived from the previous layer output.` | The run | Auto-derived input feature count. Required. Advanced. |
| Recurrent | Hidden Size | `hidden_size` | Integer | `256` | `1-1048576` | The run | Hidden-state width. Required. |
| Recurrent | Layers | `num_layers` | Integer | `1` | `1-1048576` | The run | Number of stacked recurrent layers. Required. |
| Recurrent | Bidirectional | `bidirectional` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Run explicit forward and reverse GRU branches. Required. |
| Output | Return Sequences | `return_sequences` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Return every timestep instead of the final timestep. Required. |
| Regularization | Dropout | `dropout` | Number | `0.0` | `0.0-0.0` | The run | Must remain 0.0; use an explicit Dropout node. Required. |
| Fine-tuning | Frozen | `frozen` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Keeps this layer's weights as they are while the rest of the model trains: no gradient step, no weight decay, no optimizer memory. Use it on layers that start from a weights file (fine-tuning), then turn it off to train them too. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |
| --- | --- |
| Training (the compiled model) | Yes, as a layer of the model: compiled as a trainable recurrent model layer |

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Usage

```text
Input: [batch, sequence_length, features]. Output can retain all timesteps or select the final timestep.
```

## Tips

- Use the Output pin; the legacy Hidden pin is not routed separately.
